title: I Tested Unity AI So You Don't Have To
author: migus88
selftext:
Hey all! Last week I tested Unity AI across 3 scenarios: building a full small game, level design, and quick prototyping.

Short version: it's mostly "meh". The one use case that kind of works is throwaway prototyping — but don't try to iterate on the prototype.

Released a video on my channel with a deeper dive into what works and what doesn't.
